title: Water Conservation Drive: Drawing and Quiz Competitions
excerpt: In collaboration with NYKS, Megh Foundation used art and learning-based competitions to build practical water-saving awareness.
coverImageAlt: Students participating in drawing and quiz events on water conservation
bodyMarkdown:
## Learning through participation

To strengthen public understanding of water stewardship, Megh Foundation and NYKS conducted two interactive formats: a drawing competition and a quiz competition focused on water conservation.

## Engagement outcomes

- Creative expression of local water challenges
- Better awareness of water-saving methods
- Increased youth participation in sustainability dialogue

## Why this format works

When awareness is made participatory, communities remember and act. These events transformed environmental messaging into practical, local responsibility.
